results.title: Nigeria’s disappeared: Families left to struggle for answers in a labyrinth of secret detentions
results.snippet:
As Nigeria has not passed any specific law against enforced disappearances, treaty rules cannot be used to punish culpable officers in local courts, legal experts explained. The system itself does not see these abductions as a distinct crime.

Without a statutory national authority tasked with registering the disappeared, tracking these cases often falls back on a fragmented patchwork of databases
